documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for OUTCOME OF BOARD MEETING HELD ON 27.08.2026
Fixation Of Book Closure Dates For The 41St AGM
Clarification With Respect To Disclosure Appearing On Portal Of BSE / NSE

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, with sales volumes dropping to 5,278 tons due to trade route disruptions and material shortages in April and May, before normalizing in June. Management highlighted the highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and a PAT of 20 crores, alongside capacity additions and ongoing restructuring through Tieramet Limited. The company guided for a 12% to 15% volume growth and an EBITDA margin of 5% to 5.5% for the full year. Bhagyanagar India Limited released its investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, highlighting a consolidated revenue of Rs. 70,507.54 lakhs and a PAT of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Export contribution for the year is projected between 12% and 15%.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, see, the copper prices are out of our control. At 15% volume growth, you can do the reverse math based on the copper prices to see when we achieve it. But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets 25% CAGR over the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company is aiming for 5,000 crores turnover by the year 2030.
guidance.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% minimum every year.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices. Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to consume around 2.4 million metric tons of copper by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double in the next 5 years from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: World copper consumption is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in copper demand will mainly be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

capex_expansion.claim: The management proposed a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finished adding a capacity of 35,000 metric tons which is currently online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for around June of next financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity reached 35,000 metric tonne this year with the new facility near Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: Removal of customs duty from 1st January 2025 helped increase margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: Operational EBITDA margin is 46%, and PAT margin is 2.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Our operational EBITDA margin is 46%, our PAT margin is 2.1%, and our PE ratio is 17.71%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved around 62 rupees per kg EBITDA in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Silver-bearing and tin-bearing bus bar products will give roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter reached 5,278 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of 5,200 tons total volume, 2,200 tons were achieved in the month of June.
orders_capacity.quote: But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The company exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America in the last quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: In the last quarter itself, we have exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America and we are also exporting a lot of transformer products all over the world.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonne.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The first round of fund raising has been finalized at 52 crores, with funds expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected long-term debt in 2030 is estimated between 300 and 350 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: Total equity increased through retained earnings rather than dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade routes were disrupted and material shortage occurred across the country in the first two months.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: An input tax credit reversal case of 17 crores under GST was raised due to retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Scrap material coming from the Gulf region has suddenly dried up.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping lines carrying material from the rest of the world have been diverted.
risks_headwinds.quote: And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a complete digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute 40 crores of capex across FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The second tranche of fund raising will likely happen around March after the demerger is completed.
management_commitments.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

management_commitments.claim: The NCLT hearing is scheduled on 7.08.2026.
The government mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management is planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company hopes to reach about 7-10% contribution from silver and tin bearing sectors in the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: The contribution to our top line is very, very small right now, but going forward, in the next 3 to 5 years, we hope to reach about 7-10% in the sectors.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
